summary.name: Seedance 1.0
summary.one_liner: ByteDance's Seedance 1.0 is an AI video generation model that creates multi-shot videos up to 1080p from text and image prompts.
use_cases: generating short narrative videos from text prompts
turning a still image into an animated video
producing stylized video in photorealism, cyberpunk, or illustration styles
prototyping camera movements and multi-character scenes
summary.what_it_does:
Seedance 1.0 generates video from both text and image inputs, with support for multi-shot sequences that keep the main subject, visual style, and atmosphere consistent across shot transitions. The page says it outputs 1080p video with smooth, stable motion and handles large-scale movement as well as subtle expressions. It is described as accurately interpreting diverse styles (e.g., photorealism, cyberpunk, illustration, felt texture) and following natural-language prompts for multi-agent interactions, complex action sequences, and camera movements. ByteDance reports internal benchmark results (SeedVideoBench-1.0) and cites Artificial Analysis video arena leaderboards as of 2025-06-09 for T2V and I2V.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">unknown
notable: Native multi-shot storytelling with subject and style consistency across cuts
Outputs 1080p video from text or image prompts
